description.value: Thai Away Home is an authentic Thai restaurant on Granville Street in downtown Vancouver, part of a small local franchise known for its approachable menu of curries, noodles, and signature crispy fried chicken. The restaurant emphasizes fresh, locally sourced ingredients and caters to a wide range of dietary needs with vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options. It is wheelchair accessible and offers dine-in, takeout, and delivery, making it a practical stop for cyclists passing through the Granville corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 47m; stands (4 spaces) at 85m; stands (5 spaces) at 96m. Total: 13 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms dine-in, takeout, and delivery service, and explicitly states the menu includes vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options, corroborating OSM's diet:vegetarian=yes tag. No evidence of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or device charging appears in either the OSM tags or website content. The Granville@thaiaway.com email and a menu note ('BEERS Granville Location Only') corroborate this is the Granville Street location, though the exact street number is not confirmed by the website text.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, actively operating Thai restaurant in a central Vancouver cycling corridor with confirmed takeout service and broad dietary options; a useful refuelling stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states menu includes 'vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options'; menu lists tofu/veggie curry substitutions

wow_evidence: part of a small local franchise
